frontlist.title: When do new titles open?
frontlist.body: Every title has a shelf date. From that date, the title opens in stages by plan:
frontlist.blueNote: Blue accounts can open samples of new titles from the shelf date.

loyalty.title: Loyalty status and Magna Points
loyalty.subtitle: Status is based on annual spending and applies on top of any membership type.
loyalty.points: Magna Points: {{percent}}% store credit on regular purchases (up to {{campaign}}% in special campaigns). Points are valid for {{months}} months, cannot be cashed out or transferred, are credited after the return period ends, and are cancelled if the purchase is cancelled.

audioHours.a: Every audiobook on the shelf is open to paid plans, limited by hours per month: Silver 5 hours, Gold 20 hours, Platinum 60 hours per account. Hours count the length of book content played, not how long you listen, so listening at 2× uses your hours twice as fast. Samples do not count. Annual plans are also counted per month. When your hours run out, playback stops and you can upgrade or wait for next month’s hours.

frontlist.q: When can I read new titles?
frontlist.a: Every title has a shelf date. Platinum opens it that day, Gold {{goldDays}} days later, institutions {{institutionDays}} days later, and Silver {{silverDays}} days later. The opening date for your plan is shown on the book page.

unitPurchase.q: Can I buy a single e-book or audiobook?
unitPurchase.a: No. CakraNexa e-books and audiobooks open only through a plan, and a Blue account opens their samples. Print books can still be bought as usual.

billing.q: What is the difference between monthly and annual billing?
billing.a: Annual billing is paid once a year at the price of 10 months, so you save 2 months compared with monthly billing.

payment.q: How do I pay for a plan?
payment.a: Plans are paid by bank transfer to the official PT Cakrawala Magna Scientia account, with a unique code at the end of the amount. Your plan becomes active once our Finance team confirms the payment. For renewals, we send an invoice and reminders before the due date.

grace.q: What if a payment is late?
grace.a: There is a {{graceDays}}-day grace period and your access stays open. After that access is locked, but your reading progress and notes are kept for {{retentionMonths}} months and reconnect as soon as you pay.

changePlan.a: Yes. Upgrades take effect immediately with a prorated payment for the difference. Downgrades take effect from the next billing period.

cancel.q: Can I cancel at any time?
cancel.a: Yes, directly from your account page. Your plan stays active until the end of the period you paid for, and there is no further charge. Your reading progress and notes are kept if you subscribe again.

devices.q: On how many devices can I read?
devices.a: Each account can use {{devices}} devices, with one active reading or listening session at a time. If you open a title on another device, the session moves from the previous device. A device can be released once every {{releaseDays}} days. There are no PDF downloads; all access is through the cloud reader and player.

institutions.q: I represent a university or library. Which plan fits?
institutions.a: Institution & Library Network: whole-shelf access for concurrent users on an annual contract; new titles open {{institutionDays}} days after their shelf date. Request a quote on the institutions page.

samples.a: There is no free trial. A Blue account is free forever and opens a sample of every title: {{sampleMin}}–{{sampleMax}}% of an e-book and {{sampleMinutes}} minutes of an audiobook. To read or listen in full, choose Silver, Gold, or Platinum.

titleQuota.q: How does the e-book title allowance work?
titleQuota.a: Silver opens {{silverTitles}} and Gold {{goldTitles}} e-book titles each month. Choose a title on its book page; the choice is locked right away and the title stays readable until the next allowance opens. Unused allowance does not carry over, and annual plans are also counted per month. Platinum opens the whole shelf with no allowance.

family.q: How do Platinum family accounts work?
family.a: A Platinum owner can add {{familyAccounts}} family accounts. Each account has its own shelf, devices, session, and {{platinumHours}} audio hours. Family accounts end together with the owner’s plan.

membershipTerms.title: Cakrawala Magna Society Membership Terms
membershipTerms.intro: These terms apply to CakraNexa paid memberships operated by PT Cakrawala Magna Scientia. This document is a draft and may change before sign-up opens.

plans.title: 1. Plans and prices
plans.body: Membership consists of Blue (free, samples), Silver, Gold, and Platinum. Each plan’s price, allowances, and benefits are shown on the membership page when you sign up. The annual price equals 10 times the monthly price. All prices are in Indonesian Rupiah. There is no free trial and no sale of single e-books or audiobooks.

quota.title: 2. Title allowance and audio hours
quota.body: Silver ({{silverTitles}} titles) and Gold ({{goldTitles}} titles) receive a monthly e-book allowance; a chosen title is locked right away and stays readable until the next allowance opens. Audio hours count the duration of book content played, per account, per month. Unused allowance does not carry over, and annual plans are counted per month. Samples do not use the allowance.

billing.title: 3. Invoices and payment
billing.body: Payment is made by bank transfer to the official PT Cakrawala Magna Scientia account with a unique code. The membership period starts when our Finance team confirms the payment. Renewal invoices are issued {{d1}} days before the period ends, with reminders {{d1}}, {{d2}}, and {{d3}} days before and on the due date.

grace.title: 4. Grace period and locked access
grace.body: If an invoice is unpaid on the due date, the membership enters a {{graceDays}}-day grace period and access stays open. After that, membership access is locked. Reading progress and notes are kept for {{retentionMonths}} months and reconnect when you subscribe again at the regular price.

changes.title: 5. Changing plans
changes.body: Upgrades and monthly-to-annual changes take effect immediately: the unused value of the current period becomes a prorated credit, and a new period starts on the day the difference is paid. Downgrades and annual-to-monthly changes take effect at the end of the current period. If your active devices exceed the new plan's limit, you will be asked to release a device.

cancel.title: 6. Cancellation
cancel.body: You can cancel at any time from My Membership without contacting an administrator. Access stays open until the end of the paid period, there is no further invoice, and you can undo the cancellation before the period ends. Payments for the current period are not refunded, except where required by law.

digital.title: 7. Digital access and devices
digital.body: A plan grants a personal reading/listening licence while the membership is active, through the cloud reader and player with no file downloads. Each account uses at most {{devices}} devices with one active session at a time, and content carries an account watermark. A device can be released once every {{releaseDays}} days. Misuse (such as account sharing or automated page turning) may suspend access.

frontlist.title: 8. New titles
frontlist.body: Every title has a shelf date. A title opens on that date for Platinum, {{goldDays}} days later for Gold, {{institutionDays}} days later for institutions, and {{silverDays}} days later for Silver. Opening dates are shown on each book page.

privacy.title: 9. Personal data
privacy.body: We process your name, email, and invoice history to manage your membership, and access logs for content security.

updates.title: 10. Changes to these terms
updates.body: Changes to prices or terms are announced by email before they apply to your next renewal.

contact.title: 11. Contact
contact.body: Questions about membership can be sent through the CakraNexa Contact page.
